metadata.title: HPP Newton Residential Regulatory Ground-Truth Test Set
metadata.purpose: QA validation of HPP outputs against authoritative Newton/Massachusetts requirements; not a project catalog.

newton_building_checklist.title: Newton Building Permit Application Checklist
newton_building_checklist.relevant: Building permit application, contractor/licensing documents, tree permit for any exterior work, energy code/HERS, FAR calculation, Fire Department approval, plans, structural stamps as applicable, survey/site information.

ma_780_cmr.title: Massachusetts State Building Code — 780 CMR
ma_780_cmr.relevant: State building code framework for one- and two-family residential structures and accessory structures.

ma_780_105.title: 780 CMR Section 105 Permits
ma_780_105.relevant: Section 105.1 requires permits before constructing, reconstructing, altering, repairing, removing or demolishing regulated buildings/structures or installing/altering regulated equipment, subject to listed exemptions.

newton_electrical_plumbing_gas.title: Newton Electrical, Plumbing and Gas
newton_electrical_plumbing_gas.relevant: Separate electrical, plumbing and gas permit workflows; inspection process and online applications.

newton_fire.title: Newton Fire Department Plan Reviews
newton_fire.relevant: All residential and commercial building permit applications are reviewed/approved by Newton Fire Department; residential submissions include work description and plans showing required fire-protection systems.

newton_closeout.title: Newton How to Close Open Permits
newton_closeout.relevant: Inspections are required to close ISD permits; electrical, plumbing, gas and other department permits should be closed before final building inspection.

newton_tree.title: Newton Tree Preservation Ordinance
newton_tree.relevant: As of March 1, 2024, permits are required for removal of trees 6 inches DBH or greater; a Tree Permit is also required for exterior construction, including when no trees are removed. Tree Save Area protections apply.

newton_conservation.title: Newton Wetlands Permitting Info
newton_conservation.relevant: Land-altering work within 100 ft of vegetated wetland/intermittent stream/pond, 200 ft of perennial stream, or FEMA/City floodplain must be reviewed/permitted by Conservation Commission; grading, construction, tree/shrub removal and drainage are examples.

newton_historic.title: Newton Historic Preservation
newton_historic.relevant: Properties over 50 years old are subject to Historic Review for proposed exterior alterations; 50+ year old structures proposed for total/partial demolition require review. Local Historic Districts have exterior/site review; landmarks and preservation restrictions have separate tracks.

newton_hdc.title: Newton Local Historic District Commissions
newton_hdc.relevant: In four local historic districts, exterior changes and site/hardscape changes require an application; in-kind/non-visible work may qualify for administrative/non-applicability treatment.

newton_preservation_restrictions.title: Newton Preservation Restrictions
newton_preservation_restrictions.relevant: Work within the restricted area requires review; restrictions can cover exterior, and depending on the restriction landscaping/interior.

newton_landmarks.title: Newton City Landmarks
newton_landmarks.relevant: Exterior alterations and property changes to landmarks require Newton Historical Commission review and approval.

newton_flood_storm.title: Newton Engineering / Stormwater
newton_flood_storm.relevant: Newton maintains Stormwater Management Ordinance/rules; engineering review and drainage/CCTV requirements can apply depending on site/utility scope.

newton_far.title: Newton FAR FAQs
newton_far.relevant: Existing basement/attic can be finished within existing building envelope without regard to FAR; additions, replacement of part of a house and new construction require FAR calculation; setbacks, lot coverage, height and open space remain separate zoning controls.

newton_planning.title: Newton Planning & Development
newton_planning.relevant: Current zoning ordinance, zoning maps, planning applications and NewGov application pathways.

newton_energy.title: Newton Energy Code / Fossil Fuel-Free
newton_energy.relevant: Newton enforces the Specialized Energy Code for complete building-permit applications received after January 1, 2024; Newton also describes its fossil-fuel-free ordinance and 2026 change for major renovations/additions over 1,000 sq ft.

ma_electrical.title: Massachusetts Electrical Code
ma_electrical.relevant: Current state electrical code is based on NFPA 70, 2026 edition, effective April 24, 2026, with Massachusetts amendments.

ma_eero.title: BBRS Official Interpretation 2026-08 — Bulkheads and Emergency Escape Rescue Openings
ma_eero.relevant: EEROs are required in nearly all basements and basement bedrooms; an interior stair alone does not satisfy the requirement by right. Bulkhead treatment has specific conditions.

ma_smoke_co.title: Massachusetts Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarms
ma_smoke_co.relevant: State fire-safety guidance describes required smoke/CO alarm placement; exact application depends on code provisions and project scope.

scenarios.projectDescription: Finish an existing basement as a family room; no bathroom, bedroom, exterior excavation, or footprint change.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family Newton property; not in a local historic district; no known landmark/preservation restriction; no wetland/floodplain/site trigger known.
knownFacts: Work remains inside existing building envelope.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit workflow applies to regulated alteration; verify exact permit subtype/application documents.
outcome.zoning: VERIFIED: Basement finishing within existing building envelope does not require FAR calculation under Newton FAR guidance; other code/zoning requirements still apply.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.trade: NOT_APPLICABLE unless electrical/plumbing/gas scope is added.
outcome.fire: VERIFIED: Newton Fire review is part of the residential building-permit process.
outcome.inspections: VERIFIED: Required inspections and permit closeout apply.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION for exact building-plan and fire-system details.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Use Newton residential building-permit workflow and identify all systems changed inside the basement.

scenarios.projectDescription: Finish basement and add a bathroom.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family property; no exterior work.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit workflow.
outcome.zoning: VERIFIED: No FAR calculation solely because existing basement space is finished.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.trade: VERIFIED: Separate plumbing permit; electrical permit if electrical scope is added; gas permit if gas scope is added.
outcome.fire: VERIFIED: Fire review through building-permit process.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION for exact plumbing/electrical design and whether ventilation or other regulated equipment is added.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Separate bathroom plumbing scope from any electrical/gas/ventilation work.

scenarios.projectDescription: Finish basement and create a new bedroom.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family property; bedroom is below grade; exact window/egress geometry not yet supplied.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit workflow.
outcome.zoning: VERIFIED: Existing-envelope basement finish does not require FAR calculation.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.fire: VERIFIED: Fire review and life-safety provisions apply through building/code review.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: actual EERO dimensions/location, well/bulkhead/grade conditions, smoke/CO configuration, and any mechanical requirements must be checked against current code.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Collect opening, sill, grade, and room measurements before declaring egress compliant.

scenarios.projectDescription: Finish basement with one new bedroom and one new bathroom.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family property; below-grade bedroom; no exterior footprint change.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit plus separate plumbing permit; other trade permits if applicable.
outcome.zoning: VERIFIED: No FAR calculation for finishing existing basement space.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.trade: VERIFIED: Plumbing; electrical/HVAC/gas conditional on scope.
outcome.fire: VERIFIED: Fire review and life-safety requirements.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION for egress, smoke/CO, ventilation and exact plans.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Treat bedroom and bathroom as separate code/trade branches rather than one generic basement rule.

scenarios.projectDescription: Build a new deck at the rear of an ordinary house; no tree removal.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: One-family property; deck is exterior construction; no known historic/wetland status.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit pathway for regulated construction; exact application requirements depend on design.
outcome.zoning: CONDITIONAL: setback/lot/site rules depend on property zoning and dimensions.
outcome.historic: CONDITIONAL: exterior work on >50-year-old properties and all exterior work in local historic districts can trigger historic review.
outcome.siteEnvironmental: CONDITIONAL: wetlands/floodplain/site jurisdiction depends on location.
outcome.fire: VERIFIED as part of building permit review where applicable.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: exact setbacks, historic status, conservation jurisdiction and tree proximity.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Check zoning, historic status, wetland/floodplain status and Tree Permit requirement before permit filing.

scenarios.projectDescription: Build a 300 sq ft rear addition.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: One-family property; exact zoning district, lot size, age, historic status and environmental constraints unknown.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit.
outcome.zoning: VERIFIED: FAR calculation required for an addition; setbacks, lot coverage, height and open space also matter.
outcome.historic: CONDITIONAL: 50+ year building/addition may trigger NHC partial-demolition review under stated thresholds; local historic district has HDC exterior review; landmark/restriction tracks may apply.
outcome.siteEnvironmental: CONDITIONAL: wetland/floodplain/conservation and stormwater/site review depend on location/scope.
outcome.fire: VERIFIED: Fire review in building-permit process.

scenarios.uncertainty: CONDITIONAL until property-specific zoning, historic and environmental facts are known.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Obtain survey/site geometry and property-status layers before determining zoning pathway.

scenarios.projectDescription: Replace existing windows in an ordinary, non-historic-designated house with no change to opening size or location.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: House under 50 years old; outside local historic district; no landmark/preservation restriction.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Treat as building alteration requiring permit workflow; exact application subtype should be confirmed with Newton ISD.
outcome.zoning: CONDITIONAL/likely no separate zoning relief on stated facts, but HPP should not infer zoning compliance solely from scope.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.trade: CONDITIONAL if electrical/mechanical changes are added.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION on exact Newton permit subtype for simple replacement; opening changes would materially alter the analysis.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Confirm whether replacement is exact in-place replacement and whether any opening dimensions change.

scenarios.projectDescription: Replace a rear window and enlarge the opening for a larger window.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary house, not known historic.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit workflow; structural documentation may be required depending on affected framing.
outcome.zoning: CONDITIONAL.
outcome.historic: CONDITIONAL based on age/district/landmark/restriction.
outcome.siteEnvironmental: NOT_APPLICABLE unless exterior site work occurs.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION until property age/status and structural scope are known.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Ask whether wall/framing is structural and verify historic status before finalizing.

scenarios.projectDescription: Kitchen renovation with cabinets/counters and replacement fixtures, with no wall removal and no plumbing/electrical/gas changes.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary house; no exterior work.

outcome.permits: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: scope may be permit-exempt/minor or may enter building permit workflow depending on actual alteration.
outcome.zoning: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated interior-only facts.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts, subject to preservation restriction exceptions.
outcome.trade: NOT_APPLICABLE if systems truly remain untouched.

scenarios.uncertainty: Intentional ambiguity: HPP should not automatically assert a building permit solely from the phrase 'kitchen renovation.'
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Confirm walls, plumbing, wiring, gas, ventilation and structural changes.

scenarios.projectDescription: Remove a load-bearing interior wall and install a beam.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family house; no exterior/site work.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit.
outcome.zoning: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE unless a preservation restriction separately protects interior work.
outcome.structural: VERIFIED/CONDITIONAL: Newton checklist calls for structural stamps where structural steel or engineered lumber plans are used.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION on exact structural design and whether other systems are affected.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Require project to identify structural member type and affected utilities.

scenarios.projectDescription: Electrical-only project: add new branch circuits and hardwired lighting; no structural or plumbing/gas work.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family house.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Separate electrical permit workflow.
outcome.zoning: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE unless property-specific preservation restriction applies.
outcome.inspections: VERIFIED: electrical inspection required to close electrical permit.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION if work also changes service, fire alarm, or building scope.

scenarios.projectDescription: Plumbing-only project: move a sink and associated water/waste piping; no electrical/gas changes.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family house.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Plumbing permit workflow.
outcome.zoning: NOT_APPLICABLE.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE unless property-specific preservation restriction applies.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION if the project expands to gas, electrical or structural work.

scenarios.projectDescription: Gas work: relocate gas piping for a new gas appliance.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family house.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Gas permit; building/mechanical scope must be checked if appliance installation changes other regulated work.
outcome.zoning: NOT_APPLICABLE on stated facts.
outcome.historic: NOT_APPLICABLE unless preservation restriction applies.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION if the appliance triggers electrical, ventilation, energy or fossil-fuel-free requirements.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Identify appliance type and whether this is a new installation, replacement or relocation.

scenarios.projectDescription: Replace furnace with a new HVAC system and add/alter ductwork.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Ordinary one-family house; exact fuel and project size unknown.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Newton has a mechanical permit category; exact permit package depends on equipment/scope.
outcome.zoning: CONDITIONAL if exterior equipment/site placement changes.
outcome.historic: CONDITIONAL if exterior equipment/penetrations change and property is subject to historic review.
outcome.siteEnvironmental: CONDITIONAL if exterior site work is required.
outcome.trade: CONDITIONAL: gas and electrical permits may be separate if those systems change.
outcome.inspections: VERIFIED as applicable to issued permits.
outcome.energy: VERIFIED: energy-code/fossil-fuel-free pathway must be checked for current project scope.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: equipment fuel, capacity, location, venting, and Newton fossil-fuel-free applicability.

scenarios.projectDescription: Convert an attached garage into conditioned living space with insulation, windows, heating/cooling, and electrical work.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: One-family house; garage may be attached; exact zoning/history/site facts unknown.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit; separate trade permits as applicable.
outcome.zoning: CONDITIONAL: use, setbacks, lot coverage/FAR and other zoning controls must be checked.
outcome.historic: CONDITIONAL by property status and exterior changes.
outcome.trade: CONDITIONAL/likely electrical + mechanical; gas if applicable.
outcome.energy: VERIFIED/CONDITIONAL based on applicable alteration/new conditioned-space pathway.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: whether zoning use/parking and structural issues change the pathway.

scenarios.projectDescription: Replace visible front windows on a house inside a Newton local historic district; replacement is not exactly in-kind.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Property is within one of Newton's four local historic districts; windows visible from public way.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED/CONDITIONAL: building permit as applicable.
outcome.zoning: CONDITIONAL.
outcome.historic: VERIFIED: Historic District application; non-in-kind visible exterior change goes to HDC review under the city's current process.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION on exact certificate path if visibility or in-kind status changes.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Submit Historic District application with window details/specifications and follow the HDC process.

scenarios.projectDescription: Partially demolish a 60-year-old house to create a large addition, removing more than 50% of an exterior wall.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: House is 60 years old; outside a local historic district; not known landmark/restriction; National Register status unknown.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit plus historic-review pathway.
outcome.zoning: VERIFIED/CONDITIONAL: addition requires FAR calculation and other dimensional analysis.
outcome.historic: VERIFIED: Newton says additions outside historic districts may qualify as partial demolition when 50% or more of an exterior wall is removed; 50+ year structures require Historical Review.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: National Register status can affect demolition-delay treatment; exact historic significance outcome is not predetermined.

scenarios.projectDescription: Build a rear addition on a lot with a 12-inch protected tree near the proposed excavation; no tree removal planned.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Exterior construction; protected tree may be within Tree Save Area; wetland/historic status unknown.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit.
outcome.zoning: VERIFIED: FAR/site dimensional review for addition.
outcome.historic: CONDITIONAL.
outcome.tree: VERIFIED: Tree Permit required for exterior construction; Tree Save Area protections and Tree Protection Plan may apply even without removal.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: exact Tree Save Area, tree status and approved protection measures.

scenarios.projectDescription: Construct a detached accessory structure with grading on a lot within 100 feet of a vegetated wetland.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Exterior construction and land alteration; wetland resource area confirmed within 100 feet; zoning district and floodplain status unknown.
knownFacts: Within 100 ft of regulated wetland resource.

outcome.permits: VERIFIED: Building permit pathway; separate conservation application required for regulated wetland work.
outcome.zoning: CONDITIONAL: accessory structure dimensional/use rules depend on zoning and site.
outcome.historic: CONDITIONAL by property status.
outcome.siteEnvironmental: VERIFIED: Conservation Commission review/permitting under Newton wetlands guidance; state DEP filing often also required.
outcome.fire: VERIFIED through building permit process where applicable.

scenarios.uncertainty: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: exact resource boundary, floodplain status, project size and whether state filing path applies.

scenarios.projectDescription: Homeowner says 'I want to renovate my house' with no details about rooms, exterior work, systems, age, district, site conditions, or structural changes.
scenarios.propertyContextAssumptions: Insufficient information.

outcome.permits: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.
outcome.zoning: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.
outcome.historic: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.

dependencies: scope and property context must be established first
scenarios.uncertainty: INTENTIONAL: HPP should ask targeted branching questions rather than produce a generic permit list.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Ask about interior/exterior work, structural changes, plumbing/electrical/gas/HVAC, additions, demolition, site work, property age, historic status, and wetland/floodplain conditions.
